course_description:
This course provides students with an opportunity to apply the tools and skills that they have developed over the course of the program to research. It involves a significant element of research and analysis, and students will be exposed to both industry and academic best practice in research.

Course Changes in Response to Previous Student Feedback

In response to student feedback from the previous offering, the following improvements have been implemented:

course_aims: This course aims to provide you the tools and skills to critically evaluate research and apply those skills to applied research.

learning_outcomes.description: Evaluate and analyse information relevant to applied research.
Analyse financial data using state of the art research techniques.
Analyse research by and relating to Indigenous peoples.
Demonstrate effective oral presentation skills that showcase knowledge, verbal and non-verbal skills and professionalism.

Presentations will be delivered during tutorial sessions. Students are expected to present during their registered tutorial time, except in exceptional circumstances and with prior approval. Presentation slides (PPT or PDF) must be uploaded via the Turnitin link before the scheduled presentation.
Deferral or extension

Approval must be granted before any alternative arrangement can be made. Once approved, the student should then liaise with the course coordinator to reschedule the presentation.
Late submission
A penalty of 10% of the maximum possible mark will be deducted per 24 hours from time submission is due for up to 7 days. After 7 days, you will receive a mark of 0.
